title: process.env and signals
description: Node.js 24 runtime lesson: A missing or malformed PORT environment variable is silently accepted, then the server fails to bind a listener. Includes executable core-module fixtures, a failing starter and instructor regression suite.
objectives: Parse environment variables as unknown strings into bounded runtime configuration and treat termination signals as requests for graceful cleanup.
Repair node-env-signals and prove a failure boundary.
Describe production risks not exercised by the local Node test.
rubric: I can explain the Node runtime contract for process.env and signals.
I can reproduce and repair 10.01.02 with real Node core modules.
I can identify a security or load test needed before deployment.
